description: Implement the complete Admin Panel (13 modules) with role-based access. Admin email is rexoagency.in@gmail.com. Admin panel accessible from Profile screen. Includes Dashboard, User Management, Campaign Control, Submission Review, Deposit Queue, Withdrawal Queue, Shop Admin, Disputes, KYC Verification, Wallets & Escrow, System Settings, Audit Logs, and Push Broadcast.
steps: 1. Create lib/features/admin/ directory structure with: providers/admin_provider.dart (admin check, stats fetching, all admin CRUD operations), screens/admin_dashboard_screen.dart (analytics cards: total users, active campaigns, pending deposits, pending withdrawals, total revenue, platform stats).
2. Create screens/admin_users_screen.dart - User Management: list all users, search/filter, verify/ban/suspend/role change actions. Each action writes to audit_logs.
3. Create screens/admin_campaigns_screen.dart - Campaign Control: list all campaigns (any status), actions: pause, resume, force complete, cancel. Updates campaign status in campaigns table.
4. Create screens/admin_submissions_screen.dart - Submission Review: list pending submissions, approve/reject with notes, disburse payout (update wallet balance + mark submission as paid).
5. Create screens/admin_deposits_screen.dart - Deposit Queue: list pending deposits, approve (add to user wallet) or reject with reason.
6. Create screens/admin_withdrawals_screen.dart - Withdrawal Queue: list pending withdrawals, approve (deduct from wallet) or reject with reason.
7. Create screens/admin_shop_screen.dart - Products CRUD (add/edit/delete products), Order Management (view all orders, update status).
8. Create screens/admin_disputes_screen.dart - Investigation/resolution: list disputes, assign, resolve with notes.
9. Create screens/admin_kyc_screen.dart - KYC Verification: list pending KYC docs, view document image, approve/reject with notes.
10. Create screens/admin_wallets_screen.dart - Platform overview of all wallets, credit/debit any user wallet manually.
11. Create screens/admin_settings_screen.dart - System Settings: commission %, min withdrawal amount, maintenance mode toggle. Uses platform_settings table.
12. Create screens/admin_audit_logs_screen.dart - Immutable audit log viewer with filters (action_type, date range, admin_id).
13. Create screens/admin_broadcast_screen.dart - Push Broadcast: compose notification, select audience (all/creators/brands), insert into notifications table for all matching users.
15. Update profile_screen.dart to show 'Admin Panel' menu item ONLY when user role is 'admin' (check from profile data). Navigate to /admin.
16. All admin screens must have role guard - if user is not admin, redirect to home. Use the existing auth/profile providers to check role.
acceptance_criteria: Admin dashboard shows stats cards with data from Supabase
User management allows verify/ban/suspend/role changes with audit log entries
Deposit and Withdrawal queues allow approve/reject with wallet balance updates
Shop admin has full products CRUD and order status management
Disputes screen shows list with resolution workflow
KYC screen shows documents with approve/reject
Wallets overview shows all platform wallets with credit/debit
System settings saves to platform_settings table
Audit logs viewer shows immutable records with filters
Push broadcast inserts notifications for target audience
Admin panel only visible to admin role users
All admin routes are properly guarded
flutter analyze passes on all admin files
verification: Read all admin files and verify proper Dart syntax and imports
Verify profile_screen.dart shows Admin Panel conditionally
findings: Flutter CLI not available in sandbox (network blocked). All code manually verified for correct Dart syntax, proper imports, and pattern compliance. ShimmerLoading class updated to accept optional height parameter for admin screen usage. Iconsax icon names verified against existing codebase usage. Profile screen admin panel menu item now navigates to /admin. All 13 admin routes added to app_router.dart. Admin screens guard access with isAdminProvider check.
